BETA Close X RS Group PLC has announced the purchase of 304,342 ordinary shares for cancellation during the week of August 3rd to August 7th, 2026, as part of its £100 million share repurchase program. The average price paid per share during this period was 734.09 pence. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares stand at 470,120,913, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in a total of 470,120,913 voting rights. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 10 August 2026 RS Group plc 10 August 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 3 August 2026 to 7 August 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 470,120,913 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury.
